text:
Type: white wooden swivel desk armchair
Use: working at a desk, sewing, crafts; home office, study, bedroom
Style: farmhouse, Scandinavian, traditional
Materials: solid wood frame with a white painted finish, black metal swivel and height-adjustable column
Colors: white, black accent
Shape: curved top rail flowing into armrests, slatted spindle back, saddle-shaped seat, swivel column on four splayed wooden legs with cross stretchers, open and airy, medium visual weight
Feel: fresh, homey, crafted, light
Goes with: white or light wood desks, soft pastels, linen; farmhouse, cottage or Scandinavian home offices

product.name: FEODOR
product.description: You sit comfortably since the chair is adjustable in height.
